REFUND POLICY

Clear terms for service payments.

Refund eligibility depends on the service stage, third-party charges and the terms confirmed before work begins.

Any applicable service fee, government charge, operator fee or third-party cost should be confirmed with our team before payment. Government and third-party charges may be non-refundable once submitted or incurred.

Where a refund is eligible, requests should be sent to contact@shukriya.net with the relevant reference and payment details. We will review the request against the agreed service scope and work already completed.

Visa refusal or delay by a competent authority does not automatically create a refund entitlement for completed documentation or assistance work. The final terms applicable to an engagement will be those confirmed in writing before service commencement.

Visa approval remains solely at the discretion of the competent authorities. Shukriya does not guarantee visa issuance.
